newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian economy to strengthen - Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian economy to strengthen - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Thursday that recent indicators supported the view the economy would continue to strengthen.
Costello said the latest Westpac-Melbourne Institute leading index of economic activity and other data, including increasing building approvals and corporate profit growth, showed rising activity.
"The (leading) index does support the view that economic activity will continue to strengthen," Costello told parliament.
The index, which indicates where the economy will be in six to nine months, rose 1.0 percent in January, Westpac said on Wednesday.
"The leading index is a function of a range of other indicators that feed into it which are beginning to show now a picture of rising activity," Costello said.
Costello said this picture was also supported by the Employment Department's skilled vacancies survey for March showing the fifth consecutive monthly trend increase.
